interventions.detail: TF 1.12 needs Python<=3.6, which is not available; used a uv-managed Python 3.11 venv
Used tensorflow-cpu==2.15.1 (with numpy<2) instead of tensorflow==1.12.0
Relaxed the old requirements.txt pins (regex==2017.4.5, requests==2.21.0, tqdm==4.31.1) to current versions
Changed import tensorflow as tf to tensorflow.compat.v1 with disable_v2_behavior() in src/*.py
Replaced the removed tf.contrib.training.HParams with a minimal inline class in src/model.py
interactive_conditional_samples.py now exits cleanly on EOF so a prompt can be piped via stdin
